title: The Second Course of the Stiff Point
summary: A second course that adds qi to the estoc's point and teaches the first bind that follows a thrust.

title: Workbook of Bind and Thrust
summary: A workbook of exercises that win the line by binding and then thrust through the opening the bind creates.

title: A Handbook of Qi Along the Point
summary: A handbook on running qi down the blade and gathering it at the point for deeper piercing thrusts.

title: The Half-Grip Manual
summary: A manual on gripping the blade at its middle for close and precise work between plate edges.

title: Treatise on Keeping the Long Reach
summary: A treatise on holding the foe at the estoc's full length and punishing every step they take to close.

title: The Visor and Joint Course
summary: A course teaching how to put the point into helm slits and the hinges of knee and elbow plate.

title: The Measured Lunge Manual
summary: A manual on the measured lunge, its recovery and the timing that lets it land before the foe's reply.

title: Drill-Book of the Narrow Gap
summary: A drill-book on striking the moment armor flexes and a gap opens, and on widening a gap once the point is in.

title: The Pressing Point Reader
summary: A reader on pushing the point steadily forward so that a foe is driven back and finally pierced.
